heading: Authorization of appropriations; reservations and distribution of funds

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter—

tree.heading: Reservations and distribution of funds
tree.text: Subject to subsection (c), for each fiscal year for which funds are made available under subsection (a) to carry out this chapter, the Secretary shall—

children.text: reserve an amount equal to 3 percent of the funds made available for each such fiscal year to carry out paragraphs (1) and (2) of section 3005(b) of this title; and
from the amounts remaining after making the reservation under paragraph (1)—
use 85.5 percent of such amounts to carry out section 3003 of this title; and
use 14.5 percent of such amounts to carry out section 3004 of this title.

tree.heading: Limit for projects of national significance
tree.text: For any fiscal year for which the amount made available under subsection (a) exceeds $49,000,000 the Secretary may—

children.text: reserve for section 3006 of this title, an amount of such available funds that does not exceed the lesser of—
the excess amount made available; or
make the reservation under paragraph (1) before carrying out subsection (b).

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on the day that is 6 months after Dec. 23, 2022, see section 5403 of Pub. L. 117–263, set out as an Effective Date of 2022 Amendment note under section 3001 of this title.
